Solve A x = b from table columns.

A is the A columns of the Data input; b is the b columns of the b input (a second table, lined up row by row: the same row count, no missing value) or of the same table. Square A of full rank: the one solution; otherwise least squares, the shortest of the best x (Method decides). Fitted on the Train rows when a Data Split marks them. Output: one row per column of A (column, then x_&lt;b column>). Tools > Linear Algebra shows the same with its sentence and checks.
